correctness.rationale: The explicit affine map sends all 24 source vertices to integer points in a cube of radius 84. Exact lattice-index and width certificates show that no invertible affine integral image of this source realization can have cube span below 168.

originality.rationale: The source explicitly leaves coordinate minimality open, and targeted literature plus SCOPE searches found no affine-lattice compression or equivalent sharp affine-orbit bound for this realization.

value.rationale: The result gives both a substantially smaller exact integer realization in the same affine class and a sharp optimality theorem with a compact reusable lattice-width certificate.
